# NoLoginTools.org

> An independent non-profit organization dedicated to researching, verifying, and advocating for the No-Login Web.

NoLoginTools.org is the governance authority and research institution behind the [nologin.tools](https://nologin.tools) directory and the "NoLogin Verified" trust certification. The organization publishes annual research, whitepapers, and technical guidelines on privacy-respecting, zero-friction software.

## Core Mission & Research Focus

- **Digital Autonomy**: Advocating for software that operates without requiring user identity, surveillance capital, or credential lock-in.
- **Client-Side Technologies**: Researching advances in WebAssembly, WebGPU, Web Crypto, and local-first architectures that eliminate the need for server-side user data processing.
- **Verification Standards**: Establishing objective, auditable criteria for privacy-preserving web software.
- **Ecosystem Health**: Continuous uptime monitoring and historical archiving of public web utilities.

## Landmark Publications & Reports

- [The State of No-Login Web 2026](https://nologintools.org/reports/state-of-no-login-web-2026): Comprehensive annual whitepaper analyzing over 1,000 web tools, privacy metrics, browser engine capabilities, and the growing transition toward client-side compute.
- [Reports Index](https://nologintools.org/reports): Archive of research papers, data analyses, and technical benchmarks published by NoLoginTools.org.

## Standards & Certification

- [NoLogin Verified Standard](https://nologin.tools/badge): The 7-dimension criteria (category, data processing, privacy, type, hosting, offline capability, pricing) used to evaluate software transparency and account-free accessibility.
- [Tool Verification Directory](https://nologin.tools): The live execution platform cataloging verified tools.
